name: TL081
description: Single JFET-input op-amp, the general-purpose member of the TL08x family (TL082 dual, TL084 quad). Pin-identical to the TL071; the difference is grade -- the TL07x is the noise-selected version, so if a socket wants lower noise, a TL071 drops straight in. Common for general gain stages, filters, and buffers.

extra.input noise: ~18 nV/rtHz (general-purpose grade; the TL071 is the noise-selected sibling)
extra.offset null: 100k pot across N1/N2, wiper to V-

typical_application: General audio gain stages, active filters, buffers. Bias inputs to Vcc/2 for single-supply use. Swap in a TL071 for a lower-noise version at the same pinout.
gotchas: JFET input does NOT swing to the negative rail; keep inputs a few volts inside the rails
not rail-to-rail output; expect ~1.5V headroom from each rail
single-supply use needs a half-supply (Vcc/2) reference for the inputs
